Welcome to MMHVAULT

Let’s get your personal wealth workspace ready.

1. Your account is ready

Your Customer ID is created automatically and your account stays connected to your own cloud data.

✓ Secure sign-in with Google or Email / Password
✓ Personal Customer ID such as MF0001
✓ Your finance records remain separated by account

2. Add your first transaction

Start with one income or expense. MMHVAULT will automatically use it across Dashboard, Analyze and Cash Flow.

💵 Income — salary, bonus or other income
💳 Expense — dining, transport, lifestyle and more
📊 Analyze updates automatically

3. You’re ready to go

You can add investments, update exchange rates, review your financial health and manage backups from MMHVAULT.

📈 Track Crypto & Gold investments
💱 Manage your exchange rates

Personal Wealth Rules

Your decision rules live here. They guide recommendations without changing transactions or investments automatically.
Local preferences
Minimum Cash Reserve
months
Below this level, liquidity takes priority over new risk.
Comfortable Cash Reserve
months
A stronger reserve level used for the “comfortable” state.
Target Savings Rate
%
Your repeatable monthly savings baseline before increasing investment pace.
Investment Weight Ceiling
%
Above this share of net worth, the decision layer asks you to review concentration.
Rule flow

Restore never replaces your Customer ID or authentication. Existing transactions and investments are preserved; only missing records are added. Saved exchange rates are applied to your signed-in account after confirmation.
Backups are downloaded to your device as a JSON file. Restore adds missing transactions/investments and applies the saved exchange rates to your signed-in account. Your Customer ID and Supabase authentication are not replaced by a backup.
